initialize_proxy_callbacks: initialize LiteLLM proxy callbacks including guardrails, PII masking, and moderation hooks from config
create_guardrail_tracking_headers: create HTTP response headers from request metadata containing applied guardrails, policies, and semantic similarity
build_rate_limit_headers: build x-litellm rate-limit headers for remaining tokens and requests per model group from request data
add_guardrail_to_metadata: add a guardrail name to the applied guardrails list in request metadata for tracking
extract_model_group_from_request: extract the model group name from request metadata or litellm_metadata dict
